author: GamingBolt
description:
Following the success of Invincible’s animated TV series, it’s now time for the esteemed comic book series’ debut in video game format (not including the squad-based RPG mobile game, that is). Invincible VS is a fast-paced, wholly violent 3v3 brawler, with character design and voices taken straight out of the TV show.

With Invincible’s original developer Robert Kirkman said to be high on enthusiasm for the game, it’s time to get you in the fighting spirit too. Here are fifteen things to know before you buy Invincible VS.
title: Invincible VS - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
MOUSE: P.I. For Hire is a great experience. It's not trying to rewrite the book on first-person shooters or detective games, so much as present a stellar detective noir story with incredible characters, larger-than-life incidents, and a bit of magic. 

Even after completing it in about 15 hours, I rarely felt bored or disengaged, much less checked out of any dialogue. So whether you're someone who loves the art style, wants another fun shooter, or seeks to dive into this glitzy but messed-up cartoon world, it's well worth your time and money.
title: Mouse: P.I. For Hire Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
